title: Links
description: Links (links.tpcomm.co): the API, Caddy and the VPS, from deploy/monitoring.sh (Fluent Bit: journal to Loki, node metrics to Prometheus, job="links").

panels.title: Reporting
panels.description: Time since the box last pushed metrics (once a minute). Over ~3 minutes means the VPS or Fluent Bit is down.

panels.title: links.service
panels.description: systemd state of the Links API.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the VPS last booted.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: (MemTotal - MemAvailable) / MemTotal. The box has 512 MB.

panels.title: Disk used /
panels.description: Root filesystem, where the SQLite database and its backups live.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: API requests in the selected range, from the server's request log (GET /api/state polls are not logged).

panels.title: 5xx
panels.description: Server errors in the selected range.

panels.title: Last backup
panels.description: When links-backup last logged a successful backup (it runs daily). Looks back 7 days whatever the dashboard range.

panels.title: Errors logged
panels.description: Links log lines mentioning error/failed in the selected range.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: systemd restarts of links.service (Restart=) in the selected range.

panels.title: OOM kills
panels.description: Kernel OOM kills in the selected range.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Every logged API request (GET /api/state is not logged), per interval, by HTTP status.

panels.title: Top endpoints
panels.description: Requests in the selected range by method, path and status. IDs in paths are folded into :id.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (method, path, status) (count_over_time({job="links", host="$host", systemd_unit="links.service"} |~ "^[A-Z]+ /\\S* \\d{3}$" | regexp "^(?P<method>[A-Z]+) (?P<path>\\S*) (?P<status>\\d{3})$" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^/api/(links|groups|invites|blocks|devices)/[^/]+" (regexReplaceAll "^/(l|invite|g)/[^/]+" (regexReplaceAll "^/thumbs/.*" .path "/thumbs/:id") "/${1}/:id") "/api/${1}/:id" }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Errors and 4xx/5xx
panels.description: Links log lines that mention an error or failure, plus requests that ended 4xx/5xx.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of all CPUs by mode (idle left out).

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Reads up, writes down.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: In up, out down.

panels.title: Unit state
panels.description: links, links-backup (and its timer), caddy and fluent-bit, from systemd. links-backup.service is a oneshot, so inactive between runs is normal.

targets.expr: max by (name) (node_systemd_unit_state{instance="$host", state="active"}) + 2 * max by (name) (node_systemd_unit_state{instance="$host", state="failed"})

panels.title: Service restarts
panels.description: systemd automatic restarts per interval.

panels.title: links.service
panels.description: The Links API's journal. Use the Filter box at the top to search.

panels.title: caddy
panels.description: Caddy's own log: certificates, reloads, upstream errors.

panels.title: links-backup
panels.description: The daily SQLite backup.
